name: Your Dry Delight
source:
Richter and his boss, Leslie, are private detectives hired
 to help enforce Prohibition in Cleveland, Ohio.

However, when Richter catches the eye of a charismatic mob boss,
a different story falls into place...

[From [url=https://argent-games.itch.io/your-dry-delight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
里希特与老板莱斯利是私家侦探，受雇协助俄亥俄州克利夫兰执行禁酒令。

然而，当里希特引起一名魅力十足的黑帮老大注意后，故事走向了另一条道路……

（来源：[url=https://argent-games.itch.io/your-dry-delight]itch.io[/url]）
